title: Register secret-annotated tool arguments in the session keychain
description: Make the annotation drive redaction. Before execute() runs (in ToolBase.invoke in src/tools/tool.ts, or at the start of SwitchConnectionTool.execute), register the value of every argument whose schema carries isSecret: true with this.session.keychain.register(value, 'url'). For switch-connection this covers connectionString when it is supplied. redact(rawMessage, this.session.keychain.allSecrets) in tool.ts:819 and the loggers then mask it. Today only connectCluster.ts:148-149 and createDBUser.ts:84-86 register tool-supplied secrets. Constraints: do not register undefined values. Do not change the connection behaviour in session.connectToMongoDB. Merge through the same PR process (1 approval).
acceptanceCriteria: After switch-connection is called with a connection string, session.keychain.allSecrets contains an entry of kind 'url' whose value equals the supplied string (asserted in a unit test)
A switch-connection call with an unreachable mongodb:// URI that contains a user:password pair returns an error message and log lines that do not contain the password
`pnpm test` exits 0 on the PR branch

verificationMethod.description: A reviewer inspects the diff to src/tools/tool.ts and/or switchConnection.ts. Expected result: keychain registration is keyed off the isSecret metadata and not a hard-coded field name, it runs before execute() and before handleError redaction, and it skips undefined values. The reviewer also confirms that the tests from task 3 cover this path.

rootCause.description: Redaction in tool.ts only masks values already in the session keychain. Nothing registers tool-argument connection strings there, so without this wiring the isSecret annotation would have no effect on logs or error output.
